sources.title: Image Captioning: A Comprehensive Survey, Comparative Analysis of ...
sources.snippet: Image captioning is a research area that focuses on the development of algorithms and models that can automatically generate descriptive and coherent captions. This study provides a comprehensive overview of image captioning techniques, research gaps, and a comparative analysis of existing models.
